description: This file contains a function 'preinit_set_mac_address' that sets MAC addresses for network interfaces based on the board type. It uses system commands and external scripts to retrieve MAC addresses and applies them to network devices during pre-initialization.

methods.name: preinit_set_mac_address
methods.description: Sets MAC addresses for network interfaces depending on the specific board identified by 'board_name', configuring 'eth0' and sometimes 'eth1'.

calls: ip link set dev eth0 address
ip link set dev eth1 address
